user.title: Harmony Deck
user.description: Adds the Harmony Deck card to your dashboards. Nothing needs to be configured.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Harmony Deck is already set up.

harmony_missing.title: No Harmony integration found
harmony_missing.description: Harmony Deck needs the Home Assistant “Logitech Harmony Hub” integration. Set it up and the hubs will show up in the card.

hub_unreadable.title: Harmony hub “{hub}” is not readable
hub_unreadable.description: Harmony Deck cannot read the configuration of the hub “{hub}” from the Harmony integration. The card then only shows basic functions. Reload the Harmony integration or restart Home Assistant. Details: Harmony Deck › Download diagnostics.

fire_unreachable.title: Fire TV “{name}” is not reachable
fire_unreachable.description: Harmony Deck cannot reach “{name}” for several minutes. Its keys and apps then only work through Harmony, and its status in the card is unknown. Check that the device is on and ADB debugging is enabled (a sleeping Fire TV is often unreachable).

run_action.name: Run action
run_action.description: Starts an action (or sequence) of Harmony Deck. Refused while another action runs on the same hub.

hub.name: Hub
hub.description: Remote entity of the Harmony hub.

action.name: Action
action.description: Name or id of the action, as set in the card.

stop_action.name: Stop action
stop_action.description: Stops the running action of a hub between two steps.

hub.name: Hub
hub.description: Remote entity of the Harmony hub.

init.title: Harmony Deck options
init.description: Technical settings per linked network TV (LG Netcast). The card does not need them. Pick the TV.

device.title: {name}
device.description: Technical settings of this TV. The card does not need them.

volume.name: Volume (TV only knows volume steps)
volume.description: The volume slider reaches the target with single louder / quieter steps. Afterwards the level is read until it stays the same, and missing steps are sent.

data_description.step_gap_ms: Shorter is faster, but a TV may drop or overshoot steps that come too fast (default 100 ms).
data_description.corrections: How often missing steps are sent again after the check (0 = never, default 3).
data_description.settle_s: After the last step the level is read about every half second until it stays the same, at most this long (default 2.5 s).

picture.name: TV picture (for automations, e.g. coloured lamps)
picture.description: Adds the entities TV picture, Main colour and Picture available to this TV's device. The picture comes from the media player itself; nothing leaves your network.

data_description.picture: Off by default. Every picture costs the TV a little work.
data_description.picture_mode: When the media player reports a new picture, or every few seconds.
data_description.picture_interval_s: Only with "every few seconds" (default 2 s). Faster than the TV makes new pictures brings nothing.
data_description.picture_timeout_s: Without a picture for this long, Picture available goes off and the main colour unknown; until then the colour keeps its last value (default 10 s).

abort.no_devices: No linked network TV with options here. Link an LG Netcast TV in the card's settings (tab Network control) first.

options.change: When the media player has a new one
